notes.title: Space Rogue Workshop And Price Cut
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8731084/460076b6ed201896d08047d7c1f59bd668afde82.png[/img]

You've waited long enough!

Today we're happy to announce that Workshop is finally available. Let the Steam update Space Rogue to the latest version, and begin designing your own cosmic adventures!

[h1]Stories Created By You[/h1]

Try yourself in the role of the game designer and share your creativity with other players! With the Workshop, you are able to construct complex multi-steps missions or quick simple events with your own narrative, unexpected plot twists, cheerful rewards and cruel penalties (or vice versa!). Your authorship and contacts will be shown right next to the content you've created.

If you don't feel like creating stuff, just install event packages made by other players and vary your walkthrough with cool new content. If you like it, vote for it and support the authors with your comments.

[h1]Price cut[/h1]

In order to involve more people to try the new Workshop, we're making Space Rogue more accessible. From now on you can buy Space Rogue 50% cheaper than before on a permanent basis!

[h1]How does it work? [/h1]

If you want to play some user created missions, launch the game, choose Workshop option. In the Packages section, you will see all available packs of content. Choose what pack you want to play, press Install and set the frequency of occurring. Then start a new game and enjoy!

If you want to create a new complex mission or an event, launch the game, choose Workshop, then My Workshop and start working on your piece of art. When it's ready, press 'Publish'. Keep in mind, before your content can be published, it must pass moderation. This way we can prevent catalog littering with mistakenly added events and inappropriate content. After the moderation, your pack will appear in the catalog available for all Space Rogue players.

Now you can watch a quick video:

https://youtu.be/7DnZmvwzfvk

[h1]This is Steam Workshop, right?[/h1]

No, our system won't be synchronized with Steam Workshop. It's independent Space Rogue in-game tool. 

[h1]Are there any rules for packages? What is allowed to publish?[/h1]

The rules are common sense, basically. Do not swear more than necessary, do not use porn images, do not spam etc. Anyway, even if there is something wrong with your package, we will send you an e-mail. We're open for discussion and happy to help.

[h1]How do I get my package published?[/h1]

After you make your story or pack of events, press Publish in My Packages screen. It will be sent directly to us for moderation. Usually, it takes no more than a day. Before you send your package to us, please, check the package yourself with Debug option.

[h1]Is it safe to install users' packages?[/h1]

Users are not allowed to do anything that will "break" the game with this editor. So, yes, it's safe. However, like in any game on Steam, there might be some minor bugs. If you see anything, please, report it immediately. Thank you!

***

Feel free to ask questions and discuss this great new feature in comments or in the forum. Have a nice flight!

notes.title: Space Rogue Release 1.1 Update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8731084/a6280a06158869d670aec933b03db485efd65347.png[/img]

Greetings, captains! 

Today is the day of the promised Release 1.1 update. A few great new features and a lot of tweaks and fixes according to your feedback are waiting for you. 

[h1]Captain's Perks[/h1]

Captain's perks give permanent passive bonuses. We designed them to support various in-game tactics and playstyles.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8731084/8c817193ed1434f0e109d7ff5f3221ff8800aa6f.png[/img]

For example, you can choose "Sergeant Ripper" perk, if you like boarding enemy ships. This perk gives a special mordren warrior for your team and increases damage dealt by your crew.

If missiles are your weapon of choice, consider "Missile engineer" perk to drastically increase missile effectiveness. 

Want an easy start? Became "Favorite" and your high-society connections will provide several benefits. Like additional credits and tritanium at the start of the game.

Perks unlock in small packs as you level up your captain's profile (expect two-three perks per each unlock).

To activate a perk, you must put it into an active perk slot before starting a new game. At first, you gain access for one perk slot only. You may unlock additional slot later and even further customize you in-game experience.

Perks unlock a little bit further in the game.

[h1]New Playable Ship[/h1]

If you have to do some serious stuff, those defective meatbags as chax, humans or oaklana are not suitable for this kind of work. Take command of a team of cool-headed and ruthless robots on the innovatively designed ship.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8731084/1dffa1a28dcf9d979c77aa9f99ac8f2ab7ed4c28.png[/img]

The ship is available after reaching level 11.

[h1]Balance tweaks and technical improvements[/h1]

According to your feedback, we made the game more balanced and comfortable. 
[list]
[*]New captain's order: "Block the bay"
[*]Now there's a chance of 2 space stations in a sector;
[*]Now you can't receive damage during mining;
[*]Other numerous balance tweaks;
[*]Fixed a lot of bugs that caused crashes and other problems.
[/list]

If you have any problems after this update, feel free to report us here, on Steam community or to support@red-beat.com.

***

If you like the game, we'd be really greatful for your review on Steam.

Thank you and stay tuned!

Red Beat team.

notes.title: Space Rogue is released!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8731084/a6280a06158869d670aec933b03db485efd65347.png[/img]
Today is the day we've all been waiting for. [b]Space Rogue is finally released![/b]

Here's a new trailer with all gameplay features at 60 FPS:
https://youtu.be/46e3t30pB_c
Just to remind you how much Space Rogue has been changed since the start of Early Access, there is a short list of cool features have been added to the game with more than 10 key updates:
[list]  [*]Global progression system — unlock new ships, missions, and other possibilities [/*]  [*]New ships — different vessels set up for different playstyles[/*]  [*]New stories — 4 different main missions where you can decide the fate of the galaxy[/*]  [*]Dynamic events — the galaxy is full of spaceships and monsters, floating or hunting luckless strangers[/*]  [*]Space news — global temporary events affecting the whole gameplay[/*]  [*]Terrible Magnapods and Crystallids — new types of enemies, unique battle gameplay for the genre[/*]  [*]Plenty of new weapons, cartridges, and drones to make the most powerful spaceship in the Universe[/*]  [*]    [b]...a lot of other features and changes[/b]  [/*][/list]
Of course, the story of Space Rogue doesn't stop. We're already working on the next content update. It will bring to the game brand-new captain's perks system and other features, changes and fixes. The update will be available in a few weeks for free.


If you like the game, please, left your feedback [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/364300/]on Steam[/url]. We read all reviews and improve Space Rogue according to your requests.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8731084/076859277876557dc5c5ea0088c12cb16ff44510.png[/img]

Also, the 1.45 hotfix is live. Here are the quick patch notes:
[list]  [*]"Random game" – if you want to play Space Rogue immediately without horsing around the sandbox setting, just choose this option. It will create a completely random galaxy. "Random game" replaced always default "Quick game";[/*]  [*]Significantly improved performance;[/*]  [*]Fixed a lot of major bugs and problems.[/*][*](Mac) If you get the App Error, please, reinstall the game;[/*] [/list]

I have a problem with the game. How can I contact you?

You can go to our Steam community, social pages ([url=https://www.facebook.com/RedBeatGames/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/RedBeatGames]Twitter[/url]) or send us an e-mail to support@red-beat.com. We're always here for you! 

***

Thank you for your support. Stay tuned!

Red Beat team

notes.title: Update 1.41 Announcement — Reworked Balance, Crew Management And Mysterious Crystal
notes.content:
It's been a while since our last news publication, and it's time to tell you what we're doing right now. Our main focus is the next update — version 1.41. It will include several quite important features and changes which are going to be a massive shift in the way you play Space Rogue. Keep in mind that work is still in progress and some of the features described below may change. 

***

First of all, all game stats will be multiplicated. For instance, ship hull will have thousands of hit points instead of hundreds. Why? Mainly, because fractional numbers are complicated for understanding and balancing, so we got rid of them where was possible. However, these are not just cosmetic changes. Different types of stats get different multiplicators in order to make weapon damage more significant for crew members. Accurate numbers will be in the patch notes when the update is released.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8731084/2d2fc7b53ea670e8eb967b4037a3673abb7ff653.png[/img]

Balance improvement isn't only change affecting your crew. With 1.41 update you will be able to decide which way your crew members will develop. Whether you need a tank warrior who takes all damage by himself or engineer with amazing repair speed, you will have such options. Besides, engineers will receive the ability to improve bays effectiveness — just like a captain. Oh, by the way, your captain's possibilities will also be enhanced. He will receive some unique passive skills and ability to give combat orders (more info about the later). 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8731084/a08094437534844d251d165040b39a00384ed530.png[/img]

Space is dark and full of terrors. Who knows what you might encounter on your way to the glory of the greatest cosmic adventurer of all times. Recently, rumors appeared about strange giant Crystal floating through the galaxy. It behaved very hostilely and even shot down a few trade ships without any warnings. Some would say, they are just scary stories for newcomers. However, we'd be on the alert, if we were you.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8731084/0c1b7b66c845d94c7dfa3bc37d3ca14ad2b2f247.png[/img]

Other changes relate to your comfort and stability of the game. Some improvements and new options in the interface are waiting for you as well as some bug fixes. The 1.41 update will be live later this month.

***

Space Rogue is getting better with every single update and the main reason for this — your help. Thank you and stay tuned!

notes.title: Space Rogue 1.4 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Good day!

Happy to introduce you the Space Rogue version 1.4. While working on this update, we were focused on recent survey results. Most of you have voted for improving in-game stories, and your opinion was heard. Also this update will add new type of dynamic events to sector maps (that was an option in the survey most voted for). Of course, we've prepared some great features in combat mechanics as well. Read more details down below:

Main Features
[list]  [*]Dynamic events. 
The galaxy is filling with life! For instance, traveling through the sector you may see a giant space monster prowling from planet to planet in search of prey. Keep the distance or meet the creature face to face? It's your choice. In general, dynamic events can be classified into three types:[list]      [*]Roamer — event object is moving along a certain enclosed route (patroling)[/*]      [*]Transit — event object is moving from point A to point B[/*]      [*]Hunter — event object is chasing your ship[/*]    [/list]These events might be positive (giving you some reward), negative (battle, damage, boarding team to your ship etc.) or neutral (depending on your reaction). Several events of each type are available for now. It's a new game system, so we'd like to receive a proper amount of feedback to better understand further system developing.
    
  [/*]  [*]Fire — fully reworked mechanics in order to make ship gameplay more diverse. Now fire can be small or big:[list]      [*]Small fire — spring up in the most cases, deals some damage to the system and hull. If not put out, grows to a big fire[/*]      [*]Big fire — deals much more damage to the system and hull and spreads small fires further around[/*]    [/list]As you can see, now the fire is kind of a big deal and you have to control it if you don't want your ship to be destroyed. [/*][/list]
Gameplay
[list]  [*]New events and side quests[/*]  [*]Systems modifications — now some systems have additional parameters which is improving with level upgrades of the systems (you need to start a new game to get them):[list]      [*]Engine — reduces damage from cannons and rockets to your ship[/*]      [*]Teleport — heals your crew after they return from enemy's ship[/*]      [*]Life-support — increases defense against fire and suffocation[/*]      [*]Shield — reduces beam weapon damage to your ship[/*]      [*]Main Computer — increases earned credits and experience[/*]    [/list]  [/*][/list]
Technical improvements
[list]  [*]Unity 5 — the game is now based on the newest version of Unity engine. We expect more stable and smoother gameplay with fewer old bugs and technical issues. At the same time, it's a huge transition, so you might stumble upon some problems. Please, report us any trouble you met, it's really important. Thank you![/*]  [*]Interface improvements[/*]  [*]A lot of bugs were fixed.[/*][/list]

notes.content:
[h1]  [b]Greetings, commanders![/b][/h1]

Work is still in progress, so you can stumble upon a few English texts. We're working further with our german partners to make German version better. You can select the game language in the game properties menu (the game will download localization files after that). We would really like to hear your feedback!

[h1]Sale[/h1]

Another great news - Space Rogue is on sale now! Buy the game now with [b]25% discount[/b]! 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/364300/

[h1]  [b]Monsters Invasion – 1.3 Update[/b][/h1]
Now to the 1.3 Monsters Invasion update. The full list of changes is huge, you can check it [b][url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/364300/announcements/detail/611738777504672028]by following this link.[/url][/b] For [b]Windows 10 users[/b]: if the game crashes, please try to install this version of DirectX: https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/download/details.aspx?id=8109

 Here are some update highlights. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SgbSk8o5Jt8

[h1]Space Monsters[/h1]

In the deepest corners of the Universe they hid, but now it's time for these space giants to return and conquer the galaxy! Or merely eat some fresh meat (oaklana guys taste amazingly sweet). You'll have to deal with various types of Magnapods (as they were called by Norg scientists). Each monster type has unique abilities which you'll have to handle with. The battles won't be easy, you should use your best tactical skills to hit monster's organs in the right time and order. Manage your team members to avoid losses, be very careful and attentive. Monsters is a new gameplay mechanic for Space Rogue and the whole genre.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/aZ2LkrM.png[/img]

[h1]Drones[/h1]
The newest military development of Norg scientists has hit the market. Forget about that pitiful prototype drone which you have had so far. Now you can buy various powerful drones at the shops across the galaxy. Whether you try amazing incendiary drone which would grill your enemy just like a delicious chicken at Kepler's Fried Chicken, or stupid yet effective Cannon drone, the result will be above your expectations. At least, that's what they say in the ads. Anyway, drones are indeed stronger than a regular weapon but much slower and less accurate. Also, drones need time to refocus fire after each target change. For now, only two player ships are allowed to use drones - Monaro (Human) and Eri (Norg).

[img]http://i.imgur.com/wKNTK6V.png[/img]

[h1]Steam achievements[/h1]

Awesome news to those who couldn't live without a badge for billion crucially destroyed enemy spaceships. Now you can gain achievements! Now it's your turn to make us actually add that achievement about the billion :)

[h1]Eri ship – Norgs are coming to town[/h1]

Mysterious Norgs have always been explorers, not warriors. However, sometimes you have to examine enemy's vulnerability with a massive armament. Monster invasion forced Norgs to provide their new prototype ship for a public use. Eri equipped specifically for using drones and cartridges. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/DcgAhip.png[/img]

[h1]Cartridges — brand-new devices and significant changes[/h1]

Three absolutely new cartridges are now available in the shops across the galaxy. Two of those cartridges focus on defensive gameplay by increasing crew' repair speed or enabling crew' personal shields. Other one - gives you the advantage in a boarding actions by increasing crew' attack speed (but reducing crew' movement speed at the same time). NPC spaceships get very similar cartridges as well. So consider counteraction tactics.

With Update 1.3 we also make a significant rebalance of cartridges' energy cost. The goal of these changes is to make energy management more challenging.

[h1]New superior and special weapon[/h1]

Superior weapon — additional group in the armament range. Each existing weapon gets new stronger but rare version. You can recognize it by a little star in the corner of weapon icon. 

Special weapon — four extremely rare wunderwaffles. If you managed to get it, think of yourself as Space Smuggler King or something like that. Very fast (we mean it!) laser, 'infinite rockets', bugbot-cannon (just imagine!) and awesome BURRRNING beam. That's what we called special!

[img]http://i.imgur.com/EAPZeM9.png[/img]

[h1]Main mission and events[/h1]

New exciting main mission — face the rebel of ambitious rogue general and cut a mysterious plot against the Galactic Council. Also, we add several new events and sub-quests with space monsters. In addition, you can try extra answer options in the dialogues available if you've fulfilled some requirements. 

[h1]Technical and visual improvements[/h1]

Our main priority after the new features was bug fixing, so now the game works better. A lot of changes was made to the interface — gorgeous illustrations, icons, highlights and other visual effects. 

AI improvements are also in the list of changes. Your team members are operating more logical with no manual command, either do enemies' crew. 

***

These and a lot of other improvements and changes are made with Monster Invasion update. Please, read much more detailed patch notes [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/364300/announcements/detail/611738777504672028]here[/url] or on the Steam community. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/wm5czKj.png[/img]

  [b]Some answers[/b]

We would like to give you a quick status report and tell about the nearest future of Space Rogue answering questions you've asked us before. First of all, we want to thank all who've been playing Space Rogue so far. We hope you're really enjoying it and we'll do our best to improve your game experience. 

[h1]What is the release date?[/h1]

In Red Beat, we want to release Space Rogue as fast as possible. However, we have our internal quality standards and the vision of how the finished game may look. We haven't achieved this so far but are MUCH closer with this update. Thus, we can assure you that the Space Rogue will be released this year, though we can't tell you the exact date at the moment.

[h1]And when these cool features appear? [/h1]

As we promised before, we do change our approach to releasing updates. Once we had a desire to make it in 'old school' way like, you know, the big updates with many cool features and content. However, it seems like things don't work that way in these times. So, here's our new statement: more updates, less size. Patches will be released frequently, but with fewer features. Thus, we will provide better and faster feedback for game' community.

***

So, we think, that's enough at the moment. Ask us any questions you want here, on the Steam Community and via social media accounts: [url=https://www.facebook.com/RedBeatGames/]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/RedBeatGames]Twitter[/url].

Good luck! Meet you in the galaxy!

notes.title: The Space Rogue's Guide to the Galaxy. Part III. Cartridges
notes.content:
Having battle cartridges installed in your main computer cannot guarantee a win in a battle. However, a right pick of cartridges and using them at a fortunate moment would help you to overpower an opponent with minimal losses. We will tell you about capabilities of cartridges which available for purchase on galactic markets. Please, consider this information while choosing you combat tactics and strategy. 

There are 14 types of cartridges available at the moment (and we expect more in near future!). You can buy them at the space bases or, if you're lucky, receive cartridges as a reward for winning a battle. Besides, sometimes you might meet wandering merchants who suggest you a bargain. Take a risk to accept their offer if you want to.

[list][*]“Focus Fire” cartridge is installed in your ship’s main computer by default. Use “Focus Fire” to increase damage to a chosen bay on an enemy ship. “Overpowered Shot” – another common cartridge — is somewhat different. Unlike “Focus Fire”, it simply increases the damage of your next shot. No matter where you shoot. 
[*]“Fast Reload” apparently allows you to reload your weapon faster. Just to remember, the cartridge has its own cooldown time :)
[*]“Weapon Jamming” on the other hand increases cooldown of an enemy's weapon. A very helpful trick, especially if your opponent has powerful but slow to recharge armament.
[*]“Psionic Attack” throws enemy's team members into madness. Here is a tip: try to use this cartridge on enemy’ engineers when they are attempting to fix a broken bay. Another Psi-cartridge, “Psionic Shock”, does the same thing but, in addition, causes damage to personnel.
[*]“Feint” increases the evasion chance for your ship. The “Stealth” cartridge is quite similar yet more effective. It has a higher increase of evasion chance. On the downside: effect drops faster. Obviously, both of these cartridges are quite useful for dodging enemy’ attacks.
[*]“First Aid” immediately heals your teammates in the chosen bay. A good commander always cares about ship’s crew!
[*]“Shield Booster” increases the capacity of your energy shield for a while. Remember, the shield is not effective against rockets and kinetic weapon!
[*]“Emergency Repair” instantly repairs the broken bay. Please note, that cartridge replenishes a limited amount of bay’s hit points. 
[*]“Firestarter” initiates the fire in the chosen bay of an enemy ship. Try to not burn down your own warriors if they are boarding an enemy!
[*]“Bugbot Spawner” creates the “Spawner” device on an enemy ship, which spawns little annoying bugbots. They run attack ship’s bays and cause damage. Both device and bugbots can be killed by enemy’ crew, so we recommend to place “Spawner” as far from enemy units as possible.
[*]“Piercer” creates a hole in the chosen bay and causes damage to the team members located there. Simple. Stupid. Effective.[/list]

Furthermore, each cartridge has three power tiers. The difference between them is in strength and effects duration. For example, “Overpowered Shot Mk. II“ increases the damage much higher than basic “Overpowered Shot”. Improved cartridges will appear at shops and drop as rewards as you progress through your adventure. 

If you have any questions, feel free to ask here or on the Space Rogue Steam community page. Next time we're going to tell you about in-game weapons. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Highlights of the New Update
notes.content:
As you may have noticed, we significantly speeded up the development process. Today we want to share with you some highlights about upcoming Space Rogue 1.27 update. Although we call it "minor" it contains more changes than you might expect.

First of all, the patch will bring new playable ships. Starting from 1.27 version you will be able to choose a spaceship for your journey through the galaxy. There will be three ships available in total. Each ship is suited for specific playstyle and tactics. Of course, more ships are coming with further updates.

To get a new ship you have to prove you worth it. Have you noticed those space points, which you gain at the end of each game? Now these points tied to a new progression system. Gain points, get levels and unlock new in-game possibilities (including spaceships!). For example, second playable ship opens at the third profile level. You will reach the third level approximately after your second or third playthrough. Playing with higher difficulty settings will reward you with more space points. Thus, you can level up faster by accepting a challenge.

In the 1.27 version, you will get rewards for levels until you reach level 7. Of course, we’ll add new rewards in future updates.

[b]Attention![/b] Points that you already gained will be recalculated.Sorry for inconveniences.

We hope you'd like two new (or rather radically refactored) main missions. If you have played Space Rogue before you'll notice that missions' plots already familiar to you. However, events and enemies are completely new.

Also, we have a good news about savegame files. Space Rogue 1.27 version WILL BE compatible with current version’ savegame files. Sure, we’ll keep this compatibility for future updates. We hear your opinion.

As always, the new version includes a lot of bugfixes and small improvements. We're planning to release it within a week. Stay tuned!

notes.title: Space Rogue 1.25 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Please, give us feedback about the update on [url=steamcommunity.com/app/364300/discussions/1/]Steam Community[/url]

[h1]Important notice[/h1][list]
[*]Unfortunately, save game files created before the update are not compatible with the 1.25 version. We work on solution how to avoid this in future updates.
[*]Sandbox mode is temporarily unavailable in 1.25 version. We want to improve its functionality and still work on some crucial internal changes. We clearly understand that Sandbox absence is limiting game functionality. Sandbox will be enabled again in the next patch (mid of January 2016). Until then, we propose you to try new revamped Quick Game mode (more details below).[/list]
Sorry for inconveniences and thank you for staying with us!

[h1]New Gameplay Features[/h1][list][*]A new story with more complex and engaging missions.
[*]Balanced enemy ships and no so steep game difficulty curve.
[*]Optimized galaxy default size. We made it more compact to improve general playthrough time and made gameplay more goal-focused and immersive.
[*]New weapon: Runaway bomb. A mobile bomb with a timer. The damage from the explosion can be decreased by destroying the bomb. When the bomb is damaged, it moves through the ship, fleeing its attackers.
[*]New weapon: Ray Cannon (available for AI ships only at this moment). Burns the selected bay for X seconds. Fires X pulses over the indicated time and deals X total damage.
[*]New weapons and ship system: Drones / Drones control system. We added various combat drones (Laser drone, Missile drone, Incendiary Drone etc.) for AI ships and Anti-shield Drone for player's ship. We still test this feature. Therefore, we've temporarily limited selection of drones for players.
[*]Life-support ship system now has united Life-support / Medbay functionality. In other words, Life-support system now provides O2 AND heals injured crew members (while they are inside the Life-support bay).[/list]

[h1]Important Changes[/h1][list][*]New UI system with additional animations and useful hints. Also, this system opens a possibility for quick further improvements based on your feedback.
[*]Now, if you switch the camera to an enemy ship you will able to see and control your ship with its own mini-map displaying on the left side of the screen.
[*]You can change the size of the mini-maps on the fly by dragging "Scale" button.
Numerous bug fixes.[/list]

notes.title: Word from developers. Upcoming Space Rogue update
notes.content:
Hello. In this post we want to explain current state of the Space Rogue and our goals.

First of all, we encountered many problems with game UI (user interface system). It is in [i]full rework[/i] now. It requires time. However, new UI allows us greatly increase usability and implement various important fixes you were asking for.

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=526850348
For instance, if you switch camera to an enemy ship you will able to see and control your ship with its own mini-map displaying on the left side of the screen. 

In addition, size of the mini-maps can be changed on the fly according to user wishes.

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=526850837
Do not forget the new features! Space monsters is our priority for the next update. Space monsters are unique enemy type with specific combat abilities. There will be new events and quests regarding those deadly space giants.

Also, we’ll add a bunch of new general easy-going events with nice rewards and we still need to hunt down numerous annoying bugs.

We will provide more information (including the exact date of update release) about next Space Rogue update in future previews.

notes.title: Space Rogue 1.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Important Note[/b]

Unfortunately, there is a [i]possibility[/i] that current patch will corrupt your current save game file. We have tried to avoid this as much as possible. However, new game features and massive gameplay fixes make transition process from old to new version quite challenging. We hope for your understanding.


[h1]New Gameplay Features[/h1]

[list]
[*][b]Space Monsters[/b] Protect your ship from hungry space monsters during the new monsters events! New unit types added: plerx crawler and plerx producer.
[*][b]Space News[/b] Space news are temporary global events which affect game in various ways.
[/list]


[h1]Gameplay Changes[/h1]

[list]
[*]Critical fixes for boarding mechanic! Player's teleport is ready for use at the start of the battle. Player's crew members no longer die when enemy's crew is defeated.
[*]Mining is more balanced now. Better reward/penalty ratio. No more unexpected hull damage!
[*]Most of the annoying instant crew kills were replaced with the new type of penalty called "crew damage". Your crew members have a chance to survive after receiving a damage if they have enough health points.
[*]Added new modifications of combat cartridges for player' ship and NPC' ships.
[*]New combat events added. Space battles should be more variative now (we tired of those pesky robots too!).
[*]Two new big mordren ships added.
[/list]

[h1]Gameplay Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*]Missiles damage fixed.
[*]Shield pierce parameter works as intended now.
[*]Meteorites deal less damage in high difficulty sectors.
[*]Enemy engineers no more teleporting to player's ship for boarding action.
[*]State of ship's systems (working/damaged/destroyed) change properly now.
[*]Battle cartridges are fixed in various ways. Cartridges will reload faster now.
[*]Auto-attack is enabled by default now.
[*]Tritanium cost in shop has been greatly reduced.
[*]Crew leveling cost is decreased by 60%.
[*]Cost of hiring new crew members is decreased by 60%.
[*]You can no longer fly between planets with broken engine.
[/list]

[h1]Graphic Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*]HP bars of the ship's systems are easier to read now.
[*]Crew members no longer use the HUGE tools.
[/list]

[h1]UI Changes And Fixes[/h1]

[list]
[*]"Custom Game" button (Sandbox mode) renamed to "New Game".
[*]"New Game" button renamed to "Quick Game" (start game with default settings and random main quest).
[*]Added confirmation window when trying to start a new game or a quick game.
[*]Repair buttons are on the right positions now.
[*]Tooltips now properly display health of the crew members.
[*]Several fixes for alert texts.
[*]Several minor text and icon fixes.
[/list]
